## Problem

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. Ex. _I'm always frustrated when [...]_

> Please keep in mind that this project deliberately stays small and offline-only.
> See the [command admission checklist](https://github.com/yvng-jie/devkits-cli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#command-admission-checklist)
> before proposing a new command.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Be specific about the CLI interface:

```bash
# Expected usage
devkits-cli <new-command> <args>
devkits-cli <new-command> <args> --json    # JSON output
echo "input" | devkits-cli <new-command>   # Pipe support
```

## Why the existing alternatives are not enough

Which offline tool or OS built-in does this today, and why is it insufficient for a
privacy-sensitive workflow?

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references here.
